method: Z07 pure canonical-facts tests use parallel threads. The full mode runs the pure lane first, then two independent single-fork serial lanes: runtime (resident hook, scale bench, hook path, parse health) and adapters (adapter parity). The serial lanes start together, so their contribution is the slower lane, not the sum; this restores headroom after the corpus grew to the 40s ceiling. The PR lane keeps one serial runtime lane. Package isolation remains blocking in the build job instead of being duplicated in this edit-loop budget.
